dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Great job here, you really know what you're doing! If you placed this in Inazuma, you could probably steal a good chunk of business from Hanamizaka.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Shame I can't flex my "fixer" muscles around here. In other words... no discounts for Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I won't let that affect our outings here though. Food and drink's on me, hehe.
